description: Implementation of LocationService managing locations, tags, attribute types, and related operations within the OpenMRS platform.

classes.name: LocationServiceImpl
classes.description: Default implementation of the LocationService interface, managing CRUD operations for locations, tags, attribute types, and related functionalities.

methods.name: setLocationDAO
methods.description: Injects the LocationDAO dependency.

methods.name: saveLocation
methods.description: Saves a Location object after validation and attribute handling.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Retrieves a location by ID.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Retrieves a location by name.

methods.name: getDefaultLocation
methods.description: Returns the default location based on global properties or first available.

methods.name: getLocationByUuid
methods.description: Fetches a Location by its UUID.

methods.name: getLocationTagByUuid
methods.description: Fetches a LocationTag by its UUID.

methods.name: getAllLocations
methods.description: Retrieves all locations, including or excluding retired ones.

methods.name: getLocations
methods.description: Returns locations matching specified criteria.

methods.name: getRootLocations
methods.description: Fetches root locations, optionally including retired.

methods.name: getPossibleAddressValues
methods.description: Placeholder for fetching possible address component values.

methods.name: saveLocationTag
methods.description: Persists a LocationTag.

methods.name: getLocationTag
methods.description: Retrieves a LocationTag by ID.

methods.name: getLocationTagByName
methods.description: Finds a LocationTag by name.

methods.name: getAllLocationTags
methods.description: Outputs all location tags, including or excluding retired.

methods.name: getLocationTags
methods.description: Searches for location tags by a search string.

methods.name: retireLocation
methods.description: Marks a location as retired with a reason.

methods.name: unretireLocation
methods.description: Reverses retirement status of a location.

methods.name: purgeLocation
methods.description: Deletes a location from the database.

methods.name: saveLocationTag
methods.description: Saves a LocationTag instance.

methods.name: getLocationAttributeType
methods.description: Retrieves LocationAttributeType by ID.

methods.name: getLocationAttributeTypeByUuid
methods.description: Finds a LocationAttributeType by UUID.

methods.name: saveLocationAttributeType
methods.description: Persists a LocationAttributeType.

methods.name: retireLocationAttributeType
methods.description: Marks a LocationAttributeType as retired.

methods.name: unretireLocationAttributeType
methods.description: Reverses the retirement of a LocationAttributeType.

methods.name: purgeLocationAttributeType
methods.description: Deletes a LocationAttributeType.

methods.name: getLocationAttributeByUuid
methods.description: Fetches a LocationAttribute by UUID.

methods.name: getAddressTemplate
methods.description: Returns the global address template property.

methods.name: saveAddressTemplate
methods.description: Sets the global address template property.

methods.name: getLocationAttributeTypeByName
methods.description: Gets a LocationAttributeType with the specified name.
